text: {"label":"Behavioral Gerontology and Dementia Care","definition":"Behavior-analytic assessment and intervention for older adults with dementia or neurocognitive disorders, addressing memory and language deficits, activity engagement, self-care retention, challenging behavior, and caregiver-delivered supports.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses specifically on aging and dementia-related cognitive decline, unlike general caregiver training, broad behavioral intervention programs, or challenging behavior in developmental disabilities."}
